title: DECISION RECORD: DKIM implementation choices worth defending
description: 1. seed.zeroize() after Ed25519Key construction (main.rs:205) — correct; key material not retained in heap longer than needed. 2. DkimConfig::Debug impl redacts key_seed_b64 — correct; prevents accidental log leakage. 3. RFC 8463 §A.2 test vectors used as oracle throughout — correct test discipline; external reference, not self-derived. 4. Config validate() decodes both base64 fields at startup and rejects wrong lengths — good fail-fast behavior. 5. from_seed_and_public_key validates keypair consistency (ring enforces seed->pubkey match) — misconfigured keypairs caught at startup. 6. Relay path dead-letters on DKIM failure — correct; prevents infinite retry with a broken signer.
